what: Float pitfalls for geometry invariants on OTP 27+: 0.0 === -0.0 is false, so a strict-equality "distinct points" guard accepts a zero-length segment; and points closer than ~2e-162 have a squared distance that underflows to 0.0. Use Point.dist2(a, b) > 0.0 as the distinctness invariant (it equals the determinant Transform inverts).
why: Segment's invariant was chosen for this reason; future constructors (Plan 1b edges, Plan 3 figures) face the same trap.
